author: Huawei
description:
#MWC26 Barcelona has come to a close, and it was an inspiring few days of conversations, ideas, and innovation.

At the event, #Huawei connected with customers and partners from around the world to explore how digital and intelligent technologies are helping industries move forward. From solution showcases to insightful exchanges, the journey toward #AdvancingIndustrialAllIntelligence took center stage.

Catch the highlights from MWC Barcelona 2026 and learn more: https://bit.ly/4bxIJsU
title: MWC Barcelona 2026 Highlights: Advancing Industrial Intelligence

author: Huawei
description: Tune in for the #Huawei Enterprise #MWC26 showcase on ALL-IN Talk, featuring game-changing intelligent campus solutions revealed in Barcelona. Join Akina Ho, Co-Founder of AllStarswomen DAO, and Vincent Liu, President of Global Enterprise Network Marketing & Solution Sales Dept., Huawei, as they demonstrate AI Campus Platform technologies and new data communication and optical network innovations that advance industrial intelligence. https://bit.ly/4bxIJsU #AdvancingIndustrialAllIntelligence
title: Huawei Enterprise Showcases Intelligent Campus Solutions at MWC
